scope: The list of names a surface already uses, before any of them becomes a notation.
owns: inventory rows (legacy name, notation, evidence class)
does: Write one row per legacy name.
Keep the evidence class on the row.
doesNot: Invent a notation from visible text or from position.
Treat an empty inventory as done.

claims.text: An empty inventory fails, and a row without a legacy name, a notation, or an evidence class fails.
